name: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up
summary: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up is a first-person tidying game set in a two-storey board game shop. 3,816 boxes (318 parody board games, twelve copies each) lie scattered around the shop, and the player carries them in stacks and puts each game on its category's shelves. A section is complete when it holds all twelve copies of one game. Shelving boxes and completing sections earns XP, which gives skill points to spend on skills such as revealing loose copies of a game, pulling nearby copies to the player, filling a shelf at once and sorting the carried stack. The 15 categories are spread over the main shop floor, a loft, a greenhouse, a horror room and a detective's office. There are no timers and the game can be saved at any time.
